# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# COMPANY OVERVIEW
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

> PlastoGuard Industries is an Indian manufacturer of two complementary
> product divisions: PE100 HDPE infrastructure pipeline fittings and
> IP65/IP67 precision electronic enclosures. All products are manufactured
> in-house using proprietary tooling. PlastoGuard supplies directly to OEMs,
> contractors, and system integrators across India. Custom cutouts,
> silk-screening, and project RFQs are accepted.
>
> Website: https://plastoguard.com
> Catalog: https://plastoguard.com/catalog.html
> RFQ / Custom Orders: https://plastoguard.com/custom-rfq.html
> Contact: https://plastoguard.com/contact.html

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# DIVISION 1: PIPES & FITTINGS (HDPE Infrastructure)
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## Pipes & Fittings Division Hub

- Title: PlastoGuard HDPE Pipes & Fittings — Infrastructure Division Hub
- URL: https://plastoguard.com/pipes-and-fittings/index.html
- Description: Master catalog hub for all PE100/PE80 HDPE pipeline fittings.
  Covers electrofusion, butt fusion, flanges, and fabricated fitting categories.
  Tooling range: 20mm to 1600mm. Standards: IS 8360, ISO 4427, EN 12201.

## Electrofusion Fittings

- Title: Electrofusion Fittings — IS 8360 / ISO 4427 Certified
- URL: https://plastoguard.com/pipes-and-fittings/electrofusion/index.html
- Description: PE100 electrofusion fittings with embedded resistance-wire
  heating coils. Range: 20mm to 630mm. Pressure rating: PN16 (SDR11).
  Products include couplers, 90°/45° bends, equal/reducing tees, end caps,
  reducers, and branch tapping saddles. Certified IS 8360 / ISO 4427 / EN 12201.
  For gas mains, potable water, and HDD trenchless installations.

## Butt Fusion Fittings

- Title: Butt Fusion Fittings — Short & Long Spigot PE100
- URL: https://plastoguard.com/pipes-and-fittings/butt-fusion/index.html
- Description: Molded butt fusion fittings in short and long spigot variants.
  Range: 20mm to 1200mm. Standards: IS 8360 / ISO 4427 / DIN 16963.
  Material: Virgin pre-compounded PE100. Products include 90°/45° bends,
  equal and reducing tees, concentric and eccentric reducers, stub flanges,
  end caps, and 4-way crosses.

## Flanges & Backing Rings

- Title: Flanges & Backing Rings — DIN & ANSI Compliant
- URL: https://plastoguard.com/pipes-and-fittings/flanges/index.html
- Description: Polymer-encapsulated steel and stainless-steel flanges and
  backing rings. Range: 20mm to 1600mm (0.5" to 64"). Standards: DIN 2501/
  2576/2577, ANSI B16.5, BS10 Table D/E. Products include steel-reinforced
  slip-on flanges, PE and carbon steel blind flanges, galvanized and SS304/316
  backing rings, weldneck puddle flanges, and butterfly valve spacers.

## Fabricated Pipe Fittings

- Title: Fabricated Pipe Fittings — Custom IS 8360 Certified
- URL: https://plastoguard.com/pipes-and-fittings/fabricated/index.html
- Description: Custom-engineered segmented bends and fabricated tees,
  miter-cut from PE100 pipe. Range: 20mm to 630mm standard; custom up to
  1600mm. Standards: IS 8360 Part 1, 2 & 3. Products include 15°/30°/45°/60°/
  90° mitered bends, equal and reducing fabricated tees, manifolds, spools,
  and puddle flanges for concrete casting. Hydrostatically tested.

# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# DIVISION 2: ELECTRONIC ENCLOSURES
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

## Indian Series — Exclusive PlastoGuard Range

- Title: Indian Series Plastic Enclosures — Exclusive PlastoGuard Product Line
- URL: https://plastoguard.com/products/indian-series/index.html
- Description: PlastoGuard's exclusive Indian-designed series of industrial
  instrument cases, DIN rail units, handheld enclosures, and accessories.
  ABS/PC construction. IP65 rated. Includes desoldering pumps, wall-mounting
  clamps, and specialized housings for panel meters and controls.

## 11 Series — Weatherproof Sealed Enclosures

- Title: 11 Series Plastic Enclosures — NEMA 4X / IP65 Sealed
- URL: https://plastoguard.com/products/11-series/index.html
- Description: UV-stabilized polycarbonate sealed enclosures with continuous
  silicone gaskets. NEMA 4X, IP65. Ideal for outdoor telemetry, solar, and
  industrial automation. Range of sizes from compact to large multi-module
  housings. Available in plain and terminal-compartment (T-suffix) variants.

## 15 Series — Sloped-Front Laboratory & Instrument Enclosures

- Title: 15 Series Plastic Enclosures — Sloped Panel Instrument Cases
- URL: https://plastoguard.com/products/15-series/index.html
- Description: Sloped-front desktop and panel-mount enclosures with
  aluminum/plastic bezels. Suitable for laboratory instruments, medical
  devices, and industrial HMIs. Modular construction with cooling louvers.

## 18 Series — Ergonomic Sloped Desktop Consoles

- Title: 18 Series Plastic Enclosures — Ergonomic Desktop Consoles
- URL: https://plastoguard.com/products/18-series/index.html
- Description: Ergonomic sloped desktop console housings for HMI, machine
  controls, and operator terminals. Flame-retardant ABS construction.
  Dual-bezel design. Available in multiple footprints.

## 19 Series — Modular Junction Boxes

- Title: 19 Series Plastic Enclosures — Modular Junction Boxes
- URL: https://plastoguard.com/products/19-series/index.html
- Description: Modular ABS/PC junction boxes for cable management and
  field instrumentation. Compact form factor.

## 20 Series — General-Purpose Industrial Enclosures

- Title: 20 Series Plastic Enclosures — General Purpose Industrial
- URL: https://plastoguard.com/products/20-series/index.html
- Description: General-purpose industrial enclosures in a wide range of
  sizes. ABS construction. Suitable for electronics, control panels, and
  power distribution. Available in standard and deep (D-suffix) variants.

## 21 Series — Heavy-Duty Industrial Enclosures

- Title: 21 Series Plastic Enclosures — Heavy Duty ABS/PC
- URL: https://plastoguard.com/products/21-series/index.html
- Description: Heavy-duty ABS and PC enclosures for demanding environments.
  Wide size range including large formats (99a, 103d, 114d). Available in
  standard and deep variants.

## 22 Series — Compact DIN Rail Enclosures

- Title: 22 Series Plastic Enclosures — Compact DIN Rail
- URL: https://plastoguard.com/products/22-series/index.html
- Description: Compact enclosures designed for DIN rail mounting in control
  cabinets and distribution boards.

## 23 Series — Modular DIN Rail & Panel Modules

- Title: 23 Series Plastic Enclosures — DIN Rail Modular Housings
- URL: https://plastoguard.com/products/23-series/index.html
- Description: 35mm DIN-rail compatible modular housings. UL94-V0 rated
  self-extinguishing polycarbonate. Ventilated electrical cabinet variants
  (23-119). Suitable for relay modules, terminal blocks, and custom PCB
  assemblies.
